planets.name: HD 15906 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 15906 with a 21.6-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 15906 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 15906. Its orbit and size follow Tuson et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
